svg.title: The test track
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon. The same loop, laid entirely with clear Rust track. The checkpoints and stations are faint dashed outlines. Orange trains speed out along the top and back along the bottom with nothing to stop at. A sign reads Test track, stations closed; a bubble says 0.05 ms overhead.
svg.text: Our June benchmark: a Rust train on a clear loop with no stops. It really is that fast.
